text:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT  - service=redwood-runtime spikes in p50 latency > 800ms (3m)
Alex M: acked, I'm on it. pulling up traces and recent deploys.
Maria Chen: did we push anything to runtime last 30m?
Alex M: not from main. there was a canary rollout earlier but it finished an hour ago.
Samir: i'm seeing increased tail latency on a subset of hosts (g3-*-az3). suspected kernel version mismatch?
Alex M: ok can we isolate by region? Querying metrics now.
Jordan: adding customer-impact tag: some requests are timing out for embed endpoints. Client reports from NA-east.
Alex M: posting quick triage summary — impact: degraded p50/p95 for text-generation and embeddings in NA-east; errors low but retries increasing; suggestion: scale routing away from az3 hosts and roll traffic to healthy pool.
Riley (SRE): I'll spin new nodes in az1/az2 and drain az3. taking step to mitigate.
Alex M: rolling routing rule now: route policy temporarily exclude az3 for model-large until it's healthy.
Oncall Bot: [action] routing-rule:update by Alex M — success.
Samir: after reroute p50 improved ~200ms, p95 down ~600ms -> signs of partial mitigation.
Maria Chen: good. we should also page infra to check host kernel/driver at az3. @InfraTeam
Alex M: pinged infra. they're investigating kernel pkg updates earlier that may have not rolled cleanly.
Jordan: for handoff, I'll be on until 2200 UTC — handoff note: monitor embeddings queue length and error-rate.
Riley (SRE): noted, I'll finish draining and run kernel health checks on the hosts marked failed.
Alex M: thanks. creating a post-incident followup ticket for alert tuning + dashboard work: LINK: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1452 (draft)
Maria Chen: minor note — the existing alert is p50>600ms for 5m, but it fires frequently during normal bursts. would recommend moving to p95>1000ms or adding region-scoped thresholds.
Samir: yes, alert noise was a factor. also add a replication of the alert by host pool so we don't fire global page for single-az issues.
Riley (SRE): agree. proposal: split alert into three: (1) region/global p95 > 900ms (2) host-pool p95 > 1200ms with page (3) host-pool p50 > 800ms as ticket-only.
Alex M: sounds good. we should also add a Grafana dashboard specifically for retrospectives with these panels: golden signals (latency p50/p95/p99), error rate, throttles, prefix cache hit rate, KV cache size, inflight requests, per-host heatmap, and a drilldown link to traces (tempo).
Jordan: +1. let's sketch queries and panel names in-thread so devex can implement.
devex-bot: creating dashboard request template...
Alex M: Panel: "Runtime - p95 latency (by region)"
Alex M: Query (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, region))
```
Alex M: Panel: "Embeddings - queue depth (by hostpool)"
Alex M: Query (PromQL):
```
sum(runtime_embeddings_queue_length) by (hostpool)
```
Maria Chen: Panel: "Hostpool error ratio"
Maria Chen: Query (PromQL):
```
sum(rate(runtime_errors_total[5m])) by (hostpool) / sum(rate(runtime_requests_total[5m])) by (hostpool)
```
Samir: Panel: "Drilldown - problematic hosts" (use Grafana row with links) -> link template: /explore?orgId=1&left=now-1h&query=filter_hosts(%23HOST%) and traces link -> tempo:trace_id variable
Riley (SRE): include a heatmap panel: CPU steal / io wait spikes by host to correlate with kernel/driver issues.
Alex M: Panel: "KV cache hit rate"
Alex M: Query (PromQL):
```
sum(runtime_kv_cache_hits[5m]) / sum(runtime_kv_cache_lookups[5m])
```
Jordan: add an annotations row that shows deploys and routing-rule changes during the incident window.
Maria Chen: for alert rules, I'll propose precise thresholds in the ticket: split alerts with regional dimensions + escalation policy that pages only if hostpool error ratio > 2% AND p95>900ms for 3m.
Samir: we should also add a suppressed window for routine background jobs that cause short latency spikes (e.g., cache warmers).
Alex M: ownership: Maria -> SRE alert tuning, Samir -> infra host health investigation, Riley -> dashboard panels + templating, Jordan -> traces correlation and customer impact writeup.
devex-bot: created dashboard request SRE-DASH-789 and assigned to Riley.
Jordan: quick customer impact note for postmortem: a couple of high-volume customers saw retry-induced latency spikes causing slow front-end loads; no data loss. adding customer IDs to the ticket.
Riley (SRE): will add drilldowns to customer tag values so we can jump from panel to logs/traces for specific client IDs.
Alex M: follow-up actions (short):
- tune alerts (Maria)
- implement dashboard panels + folder SRE/retrospectives (Riley)
- infra review and hotfix for kernel rollback if needed (Samir)
- update runbook with routing fallback steps (Jordan)
Alex M: closing loop: once dashboard is live, we'll run a simulated alert drill to validate paging behavior.
Maria Chen: thanks all. nice mitigation on the reroute. :white_check_mark:
Samir: infra will report back with host remediation plan by EOD.
Riley (SRE): starting dashboard build now, will post PR to grafana provisioning repo.
Oncall Bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, incident_ref=SVC-2026-0416
Alex M: handing off final monitoring to Jordan for the night. if anything else shows up ping in #eng-oncall.
Jordan: taking it. good work. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: reminder: add dashboard to saved favorites and set readonly sharing for SRE team.
